reviews.text: Our favorite spot to wash our dog! There’s almost never a wait
So convenient and easy to use. Make your selections and 15 mins later,  you have a clean and dry dog.
Easy to access and use - great spot in shopping center with plenty of parking. Loved the concept of towels in dispenser and ice cream treats for the pups!

I was visiting my Father in San Diego and wanted to tire her out before bringing her over, so I took her to Fiesta Island for some energy removal. Found this self-serve dog wash near his house and it was fantastic! The entire process was super easy, the facility was clean and everything worked exactly as it should. Not having to wrestle with shampoo bottles and a dog not trying to escape the torture of a bath is the best. We grabbed a dog ice cream and unfortunately she wouldn't touch it. She's ridiculously picky and not sure if she was still on strike but its a great way to end a bath on a positive note. Wish we had more places like this in Yuma, AZ. Highly recommend!

Just discovered Doggowash in PB and I’m so glad I did! It’s the perfect self-serve dog wash. Slean, quick, and super convenient. No staff on-site, but everything’s easy to use and works great. If you're looking for an easy way to wash your dog in Pacific Beach, this is a hidden gem. Highly recommend for local pet owners!
The absolute best! Plus the owners are extremely responsive and kind. I texted them that something was broken and it was fixed within the hour
Love how convenient and easy to use Doggowash is. Our go-to after a hike or beach day.

My dog loves to get as dirty at the beach as possible so we are frequent flyers at the DoggoWash on Cass Street. This place is amazing and so convenient!! We are so grateful it opened in our neighborhood.

On a recent visit I got my pup some ice cream from their vending machine and it didn’t give us as much as expected. The owner went above and beyond to make it right and then some. I was extremely impressed with the customer service. We will definitely be back many many times to come!

We brought our 2 corgis here for the first time, and had a wonderful experience! The environment is very calm compared to other self washes and our dogs actually seemed to enjoy their experience with the nice, warm water. The tubs were easy to get into and operate and 15 minutes was plenty of time to wash both pups (with two sets of hands). We did use additional time for blow drying, but it was super easy and worth it. We will definitely back and highly recommend!

1st time with my dog. Was great! Easy to operate. Place is clean. I recommend bringing a towel if your dog is sound sensitive.  My dog didn’t like the blow dry but he was fine towel dried.  Price is well worth the convenience! Will be back.

Quick, great service, wonderful. 1st time bathing my pet this way. Will definitely be back. She is incredibly soft, clean, and happy. I loved the flea wash and conditioner, and I loved that I was finished before the timer was done. 5 stars from me!
Bring your own towels to dry your pet. Google\Apple Pay helps make sure that you keep your machine moving.
Amazing place! Super easy to use. Incredibly grateful for the existence of this !

We took our dog here for a bath. Our experience was excellent. It was super easy and efficient to wash our dog. The customer service was great and the staff were super helpful!! I highly recommend coming here to wash your furry family member!
Super convenient place to wash your dog. It’s just like a self service car wash but for your dog. …
